compute: CPU evidence-table integration; GPU acceleration is not applicable

classification_rules.orthogonal_rnai_support: DRIVE ccRCC residual 95% bootstrap upper bound < 0
classification_rules.rnai_ccrcc_specific_support: absolute RNAi support and ccRCC-minus-other-Kidney upper bound < 0
classification_rules.sanger_all_three_support: dependent in all three frozen Sanger renal models
classification_rules.direct_support_or_opposition: manually adjudicated peer-reviewed direct loss-of-function evidence
classification_rules.normal_organoid_liability: at least one frozen direct normal-kidney organoid perturbation record
classification_rules.paired_tumor_upregulation: Train paired-median lower bound > 0 and Validation paired median > 0
classification_rules.patient_truth: requires an eligible patient-derived ccRCC gene-perturbation resource

final_boundary: The project supports a cross-platform expression-based selective-dependency prioritization workflow and a frozen experimental shortlist. It does not establish patient-specific ccRCC dependencies, a normal-kidney therapeutic window, clinical efficacy or clinical safety.
